note: The two sets are essentially identical: 14 of 15 claims match verbatim, and the only difference is the entity wording of the instrument-deployment claim ('HabEx telescope instruments' vs 'instruments'), both supported by the Figure 5.5-5 caption. Both sets share the same four defective table claims: the row label 'Spacing to next optic' is misread as 'Obscuring to next optic' (twice), M2's radius of curvature is read as -1,983 mm instead of -1,953 mm, M2's spacing is given as 9,030 mm (M1's value; M2 is 9,080 mm), and M2's thickness is read as 190 mm instead of 100 mm. Both also omit the mirror diameters (4,000/450/680 mm), M3's radius of curvature and the coating requirements, and both pad the set with trivial identity claims (M1/M2/M3 naming, M1→M2→M3 connections).
remarks: Both extractions garble Table 5.5-1 the same way: 'Spacing to next optic' becomes 'Obscuring to next optic', and three numeric cells are misread (-1,953→-1,983, 9,080→9,030 for M2, 100→190 for M2 thickness). The quotes for these claims therefore do not match the page text. Important facts both sets miss: mirror diameters (4,000 mm / 450 mm / 680 mm), M3 radius of curvature (-2,168 mm), and the coating requirements (Protected Al on at least the first two mirrors, M3 coating varies). The near-duplicate pair 'instruments location: side of telescope near M3' and 'instruments deployment location: near to M3' is borderline duplication in both sets.
